image_description: A close-up photograph of a small mud turtle being held in a human hand. The turtle has a dark, high-domed carapace and a lighter-colored head with visible lateral eyes. Its front left limb is extended, showing webbed toes and claws. The background consists of blurred fingers and skin tones.
